WITH filtered_fees AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM fees
  WHERE rebrate >= 0.0005
),
order_stats AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    AVG(rebtotal) as avg_rebtotal,
    AVG(CASE WHEN feerate IS NOT NULL AND feerate != 0 THEN rebrate / feerate ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio
  FROM filtered_fees
  GROUP BY orderslink
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as mean_ratio
  FROM order_stats
  WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
),
with_relative AS (
  SELECT
    os.orderslink,
    os.avg_rebtotal,
    os.avg_ratio,
    CASE
      WHEN om.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL AND os.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
      THEN os.avg_ratio / om.mean_ratio
      ELSE NULL
    END as relative_ratio
  FROM order_stats os
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
)
SELECT
  orderslink,
  avg_rebtotal,
  avg_ratio,
  relative_ratio
FROM with_relative
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN relative_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  relative_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
